verification_gaps.summary: The required contention proof is not an end-to-end concurrent monthly-build test.
verification_gaps.evidence: The service-level coverage used repository and writer seams instead of independently racing real coordinator calls through immutable persistence.
verification_gaps.impact: A coordinator contention-recovery regression could pass despite first-writer-wins being the central immutability guarantee.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Race two monthly coordinator builds with different bounded snapshots through real persistence and assert both receive the exact stored winner.

verification_gaps.summary: Postgres compatibility of the new source-query collation and predicates remains unexecuted in this verification environment.
verification_gaps.evidence: The concrete conditional fixture existed, but TEST_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL was unavailable and the fixture was skipped.
verification_gaps.impact: SQLite/D1 execution could not establish Postgres execution semantics for the new query expressions.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Run the Postgres fixture against a disposable database and retain the result.

do_not_change: Preserve the explicit-build-only UI: reads and refreshes must remain write-free.
Preserve server-owned authority, cutoff, report version, frozen snapshot content and exact-coordinate rollover recovery.
Preserve the accepted independent-subset relationship between Performance and Results from earlier work.
Preserve the safe allowlisted DTO and the URL/narrative sanitisation boundary.
